description: This file defines the interface 'FieldableEntityInterface' for entities with fields in Drupal, extending EntityInterface and including methods for managing fields and their definitions.

classes.name: FieldableEntityInterface
classes.description: Interface for entities that have fields, providing methods for field definitions, access, and validation.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Provides base field definitions for an entity type, typically using BaseFieldDefinition.

methods.name: bundleFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Provides field definitions for a specific bundle, including overrides.

methods.name: hasField
methods.description: Checks if the entity has a field with the given name.

methods.name: getFieldDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the definition of a specific field.

methods.name: getFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Returns all field definitions of the entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all non-computed field values as an array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets a field item list for a specified field.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns all field item lists, including computed fields if specified.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: React to changes in a field.

methods.name: isValidationRequired
methods.description: Checks if validation is required before saving.

methods.name: setValidationRequired
methods.description: Sets whether validation is required before saving.
